card.name: Capital K starting rare names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a rare or foreign proper name or brand name, most often a capital K (also ch, D, z, Th). It fires where the name is split into pieces and the rest of the name comes next.

modes.label: K opening a name
modes.description: A bare capital K begins a brand, place or animal name that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: Most serious cases resulted in permanent discontinuation of<< K>>ESIMPTA.

modes.label: Other name openers
modes.description: Short starts such as ch, D, z or Th begin a transliterated or unusual name or drug name.

card.plain: It fires on the first letters of an unfamiliar name that is split up, especially a K, just before the rest of the name appears.
